exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

Which brand should I buy, and why?
reviewed_answer:
My recommendation: Buy Daisy Cottage Cheese, preferably the 4% milkfat version. It's the best all-around choice for most U.S. shoppers because it combines excellent taste, a short ingredient list, plenty of protein, and a reasonable price.

Good Culture is my runner-up, especially if you prefer a thicker, tangier cottage cheese. But you don't need to pay a premium to get a great product.

Why Daisy wins

Three factors put Daisy ahead for me:

Taste and texture: It has a balanced, milky flavor without being excessively sour. Multiple independent taste tests have rated it highly, including Consumer Reports and Delish. 

Ingredients: Daisy uses cultured milk, cream, and salt—no added gums or starches. Good Culture also has a simple ingredient list, so both are strong choices.

Value: You get a comparable amount of protein for less money than many premium alternatives.
